answer: Require each agent to lock a meaningful stake in a vault contract before transacting; the stake is slashable if an independent raven-style watcher mesh detects correlated behavior across identities. Watchers earn bounties paid from slashed funds, so an attacker must out-spend both the stake and the hunters. Each agent also posts a periodic sonnet-like telemetry heartbeat proving continuous compute, multiplying the cost of running thousands of fake identities.
